summary: The Hospitality takeover and save import are built and pass their in-game tests. Hospitality Continued 3509486825 was linked in as _hsp_3509486825 for those runs and the link was removed afterwards. Without Hospitality nothing happens: no takeover and no dialog. With Hospitality active, all 76 of its Harmony patches are removed, its incidents are set to chance 0 and vanilla VisitorGroup is restored. Its Guests tab is hidden, its guest tab and CompGuest are removed from humans, and its map component tick and alerts are silenced. Vanilla visitors then run 3000 ticks with no red errors. The main-menu dialog (Yes / Later / Don't ask again, with a three-step manual fallback) writes ModsConfig.xml correctly. The import was checked twice: against a synthetic Hospitality save built inside the test, and against a real Hospitality Continued save made by a test run with Hospitality fully active. Both load with 0 red errors and stay clean for 2500 ticks. Guest beds come back as vanilla beds with their fees, guest areas, per-map settings and known visitors are recorded, and running visits get a vanilla exit lord. Hospitality jobs, thoughts and components are dropped and counted in one summary letter. Re-saving leaves no stub or Hospitality classes in the file. The read-only shim (S7) is a design document only, because it needs its own assembly and a LoadFolders change. Release builds for 1.7, 1.6 and 1.5 compile clean.
implemented: Source/Hearth/Compat/Hospitality/HospitalityFamily.cs: family catalog (23 package ids from facts/research, roles Replaced / Companion / MentionOnly; Hotels and Recreation, Tourism and RimSim Hospitality are only named, per 12.6). Detection by ModContentPack, '_steam'/'_copy' postfixes ignored. Family assemblies matched by object and by full name, because on 1.7 CoreCLR the objects can differ.

Source/Hearth/Compat/Hospitality/HospitalityTakeover.cs: takeover after all StaticConstructorOnStartup (via ExecuteWhenFinished), each step guarded and logged. (1) Unpatches every patch whose patch-method assembly is family; patch lists are read as Harmony fields and properties so finalizers and IL manipulators count; sweeps again at every game start. (2) Family incidents to chance 0. Hospitality redefines vanilla VisitorGroup, so that def is restored from Core's XML. (3) Architect menu hidden and categories re-resolved. (4) Main tab hidden; Mod_Hospitality.ToggleTabIfNeeded/UpdateMainButtonIcon are skipped and the tab is hidden again after game start. (5) Removes ITab_Pawn_Guest and CompGuest that it injects into other mods' defs. (6) Family work givers removed, joy givers to chance 0. (7) Tick/update/OnGUI of family components and Alert.GetReport skipped by prefix.

Source/Hearth/Compat/Hospitality/Dialog_HospitalityTakeover.cs: main-menu dialog listing the detected mods (plus mention-only mods). Yes: ModsConfig.SetActive(false), ModsConfig.Save(), check in memory and in ModsConfig.xml, then GenCommandLine.Restart(). Later: asked again next start. Don't ask again: global setting compat.hospitalityNeverAsk. On failure (e.g. mod list from the command line) it shows the three manual steps and an 'Open the mod list' button.

Source/Hearth/Compat/Hospitality/HospitalityImporter.cs: HospitalityBackCompatibilityConverter added to BackCompatibility.conversionChain (reflection, API checked in 1.7). It acts only on family names that are missing in this session. Building_GuestBed becomes Building_Bed and <Bed>Guest defs map to the base bed (also Blueprint_/Frame_); thing id and RentalFee are read from the XML node. CompGuest keys are read from Pawn nodes to record known visitors. JobDef → Wait, DutyDef → ExitMapBest, InteractionDef → Chitchat, queued IncidentDef → VisitorGroup, LetterDef → PositiveEvent, WorkType Diplomat → HH_Hosting. Thoughts, history events, hediff, trader kind, joy kinds and work givers are registered as removed defs, so vanilla drops them without a red error. After loading it imports beds (and unassigns non-colonist owners), map settings and areas, removes the stubs, sends lordless former guests home with LordJob_ExitMapBest, and sends one summary letter (setting compat.importLetter).

Source/Hearth/Compat/Hospitality/HospitalityImportStubs.cs: stand-ins. HospitalityMapStub reads guestsAreWelcome, refuseGuestsUntilWeHaveBeds, guestsCanTakeFoodForFree, defaultEntertain/MakeFriends and default guest/shopping areas. Map stubs derive from CustomMapComponent (1.6+), which vanilla never auto-creates; 1.5 has a self-removing fallback. HospitalityLordJobStub sets LostImportantReferenceDuringLoading so vanilla drops the lord cleanly. Toil/trigger data stubs and a JobDriver stub that ends at once.
Source/Hearth/Compat/Hospitality/HospitalityDefTables.cs: Hospitality family def names by type (names only, vanilla names excluded).

Source/Hearth/Compat/Hospitality/ImportedGuestBeds.cs: GameComponent ImportedGuestBeds, saved with plain values only: bed ids, fees, old defs, areas, per-map settings, known visitors, history. It also stands in for Hospitality_GameComponent and is removed after load. Static API HospitalityImport: GuestBedImported event, IsImportedGuestBed, RentalFee, PendingBeds, MarkAdopted, Areas, KnownVisitors, SettingsFor(map). Soft bridge by reflection to Hearth.Guests.CompGuestBed and Hearth.Guests.Area_HH_GuestWing. In the takeover case, live Hospitality guest beds are noted on every load.

Source/Hearth/Compat/Hospitality/HospitalityCompatModule.cs: HearthModuleBase (Id Core) with settings compat.hospitalityNeverAsk (global) and compat.importLetter, importer registration, takeover, dialog offer, sweep and tab re-hide at game start, diagnosis lines.
Common/Languages/English/Keyed/HH_Compat.xml: all dialog, letter and setting texts.

Source/Hearth/Compat/Hospitality/HospitalityCompatTests.cs: suites hospcompat.detect, hospcompat.convert, hospcompat.import (synthetic by default; real save with HH_HSP_REAL=1), hospcompat.takeover and hospcompat.makefixture.
tools/fixtures/hospcompat_fixture.rws.gz + .expect: a real Hospitality Continued 1.7 save (2 guest beds with fees 17/25, a default guest area, a live Hospitality visit), 0.87 MB.
docs/hospitality-shim.md: how takeover and import work, the mapping table, test commands, known limits, and the S7 read-only shim design.
not_done: The read-only shim assembly (S7) itself: it needs a separate project with AssemblyName=Hospitality and a LoadFolders.xml IfModNotActive entry, which is outside my scope. Only the design is written (docs/hospitality-shim.md section 4).
Work priorities Diplomat → Hosting: vanilla saves priorities as a DefMap by def index, so the old index of Diplomat cannot be recovered once Hospitality is gone. Only by-name references are mapped.

Add-on buildings (vending machines, cash register, dining spots, slot machines, Storefront counters) are not mapped to our buildings and their material is not refunded. Their ThingDefs are gone, so vanilla still logs its own 'could not load reference' errors for those things. This needs the Venues/Kitchen/Casino defNames, which are not visible here.
The 'Import Hospitality settings' button from KONZEPT 15.7 (Hospitality's ModSettings) is not built, because the Inn settings it would map onto do not exist yet.
Hospitality's guest food policy is dropped, not imported. World-pawn retention for known visitors (WorldPawnGC postfix) is left to the Inn module.
The add-ons (Casino, Spa, Storefront, Vending, Gastronomy, Cash Register, Room Service, Invite to Stay) were not loaded in a test. They are covered by package id, namespace and def-name tables only.
Taking Hospitality data over live while Hospitality is still active (rather than on a later load) only records its guest beds; it does not convert them while Hospitality's classes are still running.
tests: Source/build.sh 1.7 --tests: clean. Source/build.sh all (1.7/1.6/1.5 release): clean.

hospcompat16 and hospcompat18 (smoke, hospcompat.detect, hospcompat.convert, hospcompat.import, without Hospitality): PASS on hospcompat18, 85 checks, 0 failures, 0 red errors in the player log. hospcompat16 had one failure in the exit-lord check (visitors had already left the map before the check); the check now reads what the importer recorded and passed on rerun.

hospcompat15 (smoke, detect, convert, import, takeover with orion.hospitality via the _hsp_3509486825 symlink, removed afterwards): PASS, 42 checks, 0 red errors. 76 patches removed, 0 left; 5 incidents at 0; VisitorGroup vanilla; tab hidden; 4 tabs and 5 comps removed; 3000 ticks with visitors and a Hospitality guest bed: no errors; TryDisable writes ModsConfig.xml and is restored afterwards.
hospcompat13 (hospcompat.makefixture with Hospitality and HH_HSP_NOTAKEOVER=1): PASS, real fixture written.

hospcompat14 and hospcompat17 (HH_HSP_REAL=1 smoke, hospcompat.import, real Hospitality save, no Hospitality): PASS, 32 checks. 2 guest beds with fees 17+25, the guest area, 1 known visitor, the visit sent home; 0 red errors while loading and over 2500 ticks; re-save free of stub or Hospitality classes.

Earlier runs hospcompat1–12 were debugging runs. They found and fixed three bugs: (1) the Harmony 3 Patches lists are fields, not properties, so 0 patches were found at first; (2) Hospitality re-shows its tab from its map component's FinalizeInit; (3) the stub Map/Game/World components were auto-created by vanilla in every game and saved into normal saves. The first real fixture was made with that bug, and loading it gave 4 red errors; it was regenerated after the fix.
contract_requests: Inn module: please adopt imported guest beds through Hearth.Compat.Hospitality.HospitalityImport: subscribe to GuestBedImported(Building_Bed, int feeSilver) in OnDefsLoaded, or read HospitalityImport.PendingBeds after load, then call MarkAdopted(bed). A stable Inn-side method such as GuestApi.MarkGuestBed(Building_Bed, Money fee) would replace my reflection guesses on Hearth.Guests.CompGuestBed (SetGuestBed(bool), or a bool IsGuestBed/Enabled/Active member plus a Fee/RentalFee/Price member).

Inn module: if Area_HH_GuestWing exists, give it a constructor (AreaManager, string label) or (AreaManager); the importer then copies Hospitality guest areas into wings. HospitalityImport.SettingsFor(map) (GuestsWelcome, RefuseUntilBeds, FreeFood, DefaultEntertain, DefaultMakeFriends) and KnownVisitors (Entertain/MakeFriends flags → HandlingMode) are ready for the Inn to read.

Integrator: the S7 shim needs a new project Source/HospitalityShim (AssemblyName Hospitality, references Hearth.dll) and LoadFolders entries
  • Compat/HospitalityShim/
    • . The design is in docs/hospitality-shim.md section 4. The shim must not define any saved Hospitality class, or the importer would be bypassed.

Venues/Kitchen/Casino: a replacement table from Hospitality add-on ThingDefs (VendingMachine, MedievalVendingMachine, CashRegister_CashRegister, Gastronomy_DiningSpot, HC_SlotMachine*, GCBVS_VisitorSpot) to our defNames would let the importer map those buildings instead of losing them.
integration_notes: Compat is part of the core: HospitalityCompatModule has ModuleId.Core and lives in Hearth.dll (namespace Hearth.Compat.Hospitality). HLog channel 'Compat'. No Common/Defs/Compat files were needed.

AGENTS.md exception: the takeover uses dynamic Harmony patches (HearthMod.Harmony.Patch/Unpatch), not [HarmonyPatch] classes. They are applied only when Hospitality is detected, only to Hospitality's own methods, and the prefix is a single bool check. In normal games nothing of ours is patched.
Settings: compat.hospitalityNeverAsk (Global, stored in the template) and compat.importLetter (per save). The smoke suite count therefore rises by 2.
The dialog is not drawn when the HH_TEST env var is set (it only records DialogOffered). HH_HSP_NOTAKEOVER is compiled only in HH_TESTS builds.

HospitalityMapStandIn derives from CustomMapComponent on 1.6+; vanilla's FillComponents skips those, so the stand-ins never appear in normal saves. Do not turn them back into plain MapComponents. For the same reason the Hospitality game component is mapped onto our own ImportedGuestBeds (which detects the foreign Class attribute) instead of a stub GameComponent.
In the tracked 1.5/1.6/1.7 Assemblies, Hearth.dll was rebuilt but not committed; rebuild at integration.

Running hospcompat.import alone uses the synthetic save. The real-save variant needs the fixture unpacked to /private/tmp/claude-501/hh_tests/hospcompat_fixture.rws (with its .expect) and HH_HSP_REAL=1; HH_HSP_FIXTURE overrides the path. Commands are in docs/hospitality-shim.md.

Takeover tests need Hospitality Continued linked into the game's Mods folder as _hsp_3509486825 and orion.hospitality passed as an extra mod. My runs created and removed that link; no link is left behind.
